purpose: Explicit source selection for the compact, redistributable Canadian offline knowledge store. A source must appear here and separately retain local-RAG, redistribution, and no-training eligibility in the Canadian source registry before it can enter a release shard.

profiles.description: The current compact Canadian field-guidance core: provenance-complete Alberta and Manitoba sources. Its geographic depth is intentionally uneven and all row-level historical, currency, and live-authority restrictions remain active.

The core plus reviewed federal data-product context, Saskatchewan detailed-soil specification context, and Ontario regional statistics. It is an explicit extension, not evidence that Canada-wide or Saskatchewan applied crop guidance is complete.
